question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Offer
solution:
The correct answer is: **Withhold**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Offer"** means to present or provide something for someone to accept or reject. (प्रस्ताव देना)

 
 
• **Example:** He **offered** his help to complete the project.
 
 
 
• **"Withhold"** refers to holding back or refusing to give something that might otherwise be offered. (रोकना)
 
 
• **Example:** The company decided to **withhold** bonuses due to financial constraints.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Offer'** is **'Withhold'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Withhold**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hurt **(दुख पहुंचाना): To cause pain or injury to someone.

 
 
• **Example:** His words **hurt** her feelings deeply.
 
 
 
• **Open **(खोलना): To make something accessible or not closed.
 
 
• **Example:** She **opened** the door to let the guests in.
 
 
 
• **Select **(चुनना): To choose something from a group or list.
 
 
• **Example:** Please **select **your preferred option from the menu.
